pr_title: soc: nordic: dmm: Fix DMM_REG_ALIGN_SIZE macro when CONFIG_DCACHE=n
pr_body:
Make sure this expansion doesn't include `CONFIG_DCACHE_LINE_SIZE`, which would be undefined and produce a build error.

Fixes #80873

issue_context.title: Compilation failure on nRF54H20 VPR with UART memory region
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
Recently, the `uart_nrfx_uarte` driver adopted DMM and exposed a bug with one of the DMM macros. It may cause compilation to fail when building for a target with no data cache, such as the nRF54H20 PPR core.

**To Reproduce**
1. Create `samples/hello_world/app.overlay`:
```
&uart135 {
    memory-regions = <&cpuapp_dma_region>;
};
```
2. Run `west build -p samples/hello_world -b nrf54h20dk//cpuppr`

**Expected behavior**
Build success

**Impact**
Showstopper

review_comments: Was there any issues with that macro?
It was suggested by @anangl. Not interested in going back and forth on this, it's an urgent fix.

why not use same approach as in the macro above?
```
#define DMM_REG_ALIGN_SIZE(node_id) \
  COND_CODE_1(CONFIG_DCACHE, ((DMM_IS_REG_CACHEABLE(node_id) ? CONFIG_DCACHE_LINE_SIZE : sizeof(uint8_t))), (sizeof(uint8_t)))
